questions.question: If ‘W’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘X’ stands for ‘×’, ‘Y’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘Z’ stands for ‘−’, then the resultant of which of the following would be 94?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05033828bccdc58309b2410d3862c53cfbbb99ad1c921a44c94d086c69ad1c45.png] 

According to the question, the letters are interchanged as follows:

 
 

 Original Letter
 W
 X
 Y
 Z
 
 

 New Symbol
 ÷
 ×
 +
 −
 
 

We need to find which option results in 94 after interchanging the symbols.

**1) 48 X 8 Y 56 Z 24 W 6**

After interchanging the signs: 48 × 8 + 56 − 24 ÷ 6

Perform operations according to BODMAS:

⇒ 48 × 8 + 56 − __**24 ÷ 6**__

⇒ __**48 × 8**__ + 56 − 4

⇒ __**384 + 56**__ − 4

⇒ __**440 − 4**__

⇒ 436 ≠ 94

**2) 48 Y 8 X 56 W 24 Z 6**

After interchanging the signs: 48 + 8 × 56 ÷ 24 − 6

Perform operations according to BODMAS:

⇒ 48 + 8 × __**56 ÷ 24**__ − 6

⇒ 48 + __**8 × (7/3)**__ − 6

⇒ __**48 + (56/3)**__ − 6

⇒ __**(144 + 56)/3**__ − 6

⇒ __**200/3 − 6**__

⇒ (200 − 18)/3

⇒ 60.66 ≠ 94

**3) 48 Z 8 W 56 X 24 Y 6**

After interchanging the signs: 48 − 8 ÷ 56 × 24 + 6

Perform operations according to BODMAS:

⇒ 48 − __**8 ÷ 56**__ × 24 + 6

⇒ 48 − __**(1/7) × 24**__ + 6

⇒ __**48 − 24/7**__ + 6

⇒ __**(336 − 24)/7**__ + 6

⇒ __**312/7 + 6**__

⇒ (312 + 42)/7

⇒ 50.5 ≠ 94

**4) 48 W 8 Z 56 Y 24 X 6**

After interchanging the signs: 48 ÷ 8 − 56 + 24 × 6

Perform operations according to BODMAS:

⇒ __**48 ÷ 8**__ − 56 + 24 × 6

⇒ 6 − 56 + __**24 × 6**__

⇒ __**6 − 56**__ + 144

⇒ __**−50 + 144**__

⇒ 94

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

43 ÷ 13 − 648 × 8 + 52 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05033828bccdc58309b2410d3862c53cfbbb99ad1c921a44c94d086c69ad1c45.png] 

Given interchange rules:

__
 
• ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged.
 
• ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged.

The given equation is:

43 ÷ 13 − 648 × 8 + 52 = ?

Replace the operators with their corresponding new meanings:

43 × 13 + 648 ÷ 8 − 52 = ?

Now, we solve the equation following the BODMAS rule:

= **43 × 13**__ + __**648 ÷ 8**__ − 52

= __**559 + 81**__ − 52

= __**640 − 52**__

= 588

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

Since the pattern for UIM to ONJ (-6, +5, -3) is not the same as the pattern for VUQ to STN (-3, -1, -3), Option 2 is incorrect.

questions.question: A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only four people sit between B and D when counted from the right of B. B sits third to the left of C. T sits third to the left of R. S is an immediate neighbour of both D and C. How many people sit between A and S when counted from the right of A?
questions.solution:
Given:

A, B, C, D, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only four people sit between B and D when counted from the right of B.

B sits third to the left of C. T sits third to the left of R.

S is an immediate neighbour of both D and C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b85a80ee20177c45d6b87b042c9109a4e0ac204e947207ea8a2824e1135189f.png] 

Thus, two people sit between A and S when counted from the right of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of P. Only three people sit between P and I. Only one person sits between I and O. Q sits to the immediate left of K. J is not an immediate neighbour of I. How many people sit to the right of L?
questions.solution:
Given:

Seven people, I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting in a row, facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of P. Only three people sit between P and I.

Only one person sits between I and O. Q sits to the immediate left of K.

J is not an immediate neighbour of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a17c5aff62d0bf69055dd425279f6db09d8fc2243499dc839252a326f273a013.png] 

Thus, one person sits to the right of L.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
